summary: ITER67 full-stack verification of the NEW Scenic Cycling admin-managed POV catalog. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter67_scenic_routes.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter67.xml) covering public rider feed, single-route GET, /api/scenic/last after /api/workouts/summarize, admin CRUD, YouTube URL normalisation, auto-slug id, 409 duplicate id, 422 invalid youtube_id, and auth gating (401 anon on /api/scenic/routes and /api/admin/scenic-routes, 403 rider-token on /api/admin/scenic-routes). Frontend: /scenic-ride?route=lake-garda renders correctly at 1280x800 as greenlantern@roujaune.app — all 8 testIDs present (scenic-ride, scenic-exit, scenic-timer, scenic-player, scenic-terrain, scenic-waypoints, scenic-playpause, scenic-finish), YouTube iframe embeds lOkouNCWSqw, 'POV VIDEO' + tag badges + 'ALONG THE WAY' waypoint chips + Terrain/Surface Detail cards + PLAY and 'Finish ride' controls all visible; tapping PLAY flips label to PAUSE; tapping 'Finish ride' POSTs /api/workouts/summarize (verified 200) and navigates back to '/'. Scenic Cycling Today view (switch via today-mode-button -> today-mode-option-scenic-cycling) renders 'WHERE SHALL WE EXPLORE TODAY?' heading, the Lake Garda hero (scenic-hero) with POV VIDEO badge, place, description and stats, and the 'BEGIN SCENIC JOURNEY' CTA (begin-scenic-journey). Rider feed order confirms lake-garda is first (sort=-1) followed by the 4 seeded routes. Draft routes correctly excluded from rider feed; a test route created via admin API in draft state was NOT visible in the rider feed until published, then correctly appeared, and was fully cleaned up via DELETE. Backend admin audit + require_admin gating behaves per spec. No red screens, no crashes.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (noted in iter66) — console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still fires on scenic screens (originates in Toast components). Non-blocking, not introduced by scenic feature.

action_items: None required — the scenic feature is production-ready per the acceptance criteria supplied. Optional (not blocking): consider adding an 'explore-destinations' testID on the Scenic Today view if you want to reuse the iter66 pattern; currently only 'begin-scenic-journey' is exposed as a hero CTA on the scenic Today view (the sidebar has an 'Explore Destinations' rail item, per iter66).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/scenic.py is clean and well-scoped: single-purpose module for both rider public feed and admin CRUD. _yt_id() correctly accepts raw 11-char ids and common YouTube URL shapes; _slugify() and 409-on-duplicate are correct. Admin router is gated at the APIRouter level via dependencies=[Depends(auth.require_admin)] — belt-and-braces.
_public() projection is stable and includes country/terrain/difficulty/surface/highlights/description — good forward compatibility for the future scenic HUD.
MongoDB _id is excluded via projection {"_id": 0} everywhere. Good.
Seed is idempotent (only inserts when collection is empty). Good.
PUT admin_update_scenic guards against empty updates with 400 'No fields to update' — small but correct API hygiene.
/api/scenic/last uses udb.ride_history with regex '^scenic-' — correctly isolated from virtual-<id> training rides. Good separation.

/app/frontend/src/lib/scenic-routes.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with a null-safe base() helper and never fabricates a catalog when the API returns empty — matches the spec 'no client-side catalog'. logScenicRide is best-effort with try/catch — never blocks the rider. Good.

/app/frontend/app/scenic-ride.tsx counts elapsed only while the video is playing — reasonable UX. Uses SafeAreaView from react-native-safe-area-context correctly and expo-status-bar. All interactive elements have testID and accessibilityLabel.
seed_data_creation: The test suite creates 2 TEST_-prefixed admin scenic routes via the admin API and cleans them up in a teardown_class DELETE loop; the final route created in test_put_and_publish_archive_and_delete is deleted inside the test itself. No leftover scenic routes in the rider feed after the suite runs (verified — public feed still shows lake-garda + 4 seeds).
